pages.text: An angry Tribe does not wait forever behind a palisade. Patrols seek out players who have drawn its attention.$(br2)Greater anger brings stronger company: ordinary Grunts give way to Archers, Mages, Brutes, and Captains. Ogres also rally to defend nearby allies, so a careless first strike can become a crowded argument.
Patrols are the consequence. Camps are usually the cause.
